description: Measure the update-count rate before using it to fund the freeze. Untimed, through the benchmark trial code: run E104 code (594b48e: bs 1024 in the 16/24 px phases as well, ~+53 steps, everything else as E100) on seeds 3-102 in one fresh process. Compare it with the pooled 200-trajectory E100 baseline (SE ~0.032). No scored change is needed for the decision. For the scored row, rerun the current tip unchanged; if E116 is banked, that rerun adds a distinct E116 gate sample.
